# `aube access list collaborators`

- **Usage:** `aube access list collaborators <PACKAGE> [USER]`
- **Effect:** read-only

List collaborators for a package, optionally filtering to one user.

## Arguments
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.
- **`[USER]`** — Optional user name.

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
